spellbook.finance/limitations: Workspace membership is backend-enforced. Every onboarding step happens on the marketplace and binds the seller's identity, money, or legal acceptance, so the agent points the seller at each step and never completes one for them.
SpellBook cannot read the seller's progress through the marketplace checklist. lane.checklistProgress is always null, so ask the seller which step they reached.

lane.liveListings counts listings the marketplace last confirmed with a quantity above zero. lane.dirtyListings counts targets whose quantity or price the marketplace has not confirmed yet. Neither proves a buyer can see the listing now.
Misprint is a bid and ask market. An ask at or below an open bid sells at once, so a seller should price above the best bid unless they mean to sell now.
It returns facts and never recommends a marketplace, a price, or a seller level.

description: Read how a seller onboards to one channel-lane marketplace and where this workspace's lane stands. It returns the venue's ordered onboarding steps with who does each step, what each needs, where it happens, and its sources, plus the venue's fees, seller levels, and accepted conditions. It also returns the workspace's lane: whether it exists and is enabled, whether the venue flag is on, whether SpellBook sync exists for the venue, and live and unconfirmed listing counts. Call it when a seller asks how to start selling on Misprint, or why nothing lists there. Walk the seller through the steps they have not done, then call it again after they finish. For eBay or ManaPool, call spellbook_ebay_connection_status or spellbook_manapool_connection_status.

marketplace.description: The channel-lane marketplace whose onboarding steps and lane state to read.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose lane to read. Required.
